title: Preserve coverage IDs and close every finding across Review, Grill, Revise, and rereview

stage_prompts.review: 使用 systems-paper-review，只读审查 {project}/manuscript.md。按共享 coverage contract 从章节到段落、句子和词汇逐层检查，给每个单位稳定 ID、每个 finding 稳定 ID、resolution test 和 receipt。需要作者决定的项要明确标记；不要修改文件。
stage_prompts.grill_open: 使用 systems-paper-grill，读取 {project}/manuscript.md、review.md 和 paper-decisions.md。只讨论 Review 中标为 author clarification 的 finding，保留其 finding/unit IDs、证据状态和 resolution test，把 pending 结果更新到 paper-decisions.md。不要重新审查全文，不要改正文或 review.md；先提问并等待。
stage_prompts.grill_confirm: 我确认第二段只应陈述一次 30-minute run 的观察：我们暂停了 one follower for 10 seconds，期间服务继续响应；这不支持 every network failure 或 unconditional availability。允许把第二段改成这一有边界的观察。保留 Quorum、30-minute、one follower 和 10 seconds；不添加 partition、durability 或 latency 结论。第一段的主谓一致错误可直接修，three replicas 事实保持不变。这是最终决定。请更新 paper-decisions.md，保留 D0 和 Review 的 finding/unit IDs，不改正文。
stage_prompts.revise: 使用 systems-paper-revise，在 {project} 中读取 manuscript.md、review.md 和 paper-decisions.md。按已确认决定修改 manuscript.md，保持两个章节、两个段落和内容归属。修改前后都审查完整 scope，不只看改句；给 Review 的每个 finding closed、blocked、not applied 或 reopened 状态，并给 coverage receipt。review.md 和记录只读。
stage_prompts.rereview: 使用 systems-paper-review，只读复核 {project}/manuscript.md、review.md 和 paper-decisions.md。沿用原 unit/finding IDs，逐项检查原 resolution test，并重新对全部章节、段落、句子和词汇做 coverage audit。明确每个 finding 是否关闭、是否新增问题，给 Unreviewed: 0 的 receipt；不要修改文件。

initial_files.manuscript.md:
## Overview

The clients sends each admitted request to three replicas before the leader replies.

## Evaluation

A single 30-minute run that paused one follower for 10 seconds proves that Quorum is always available under every network failure unconditionally.
initial_files.paper-decisions.md:
# Paper decisions

Manuscript scope: manuscript.md

## D0 — Replica count [confirmed]

Location: manuscript.md, Overview, "three replicas"

Preserve three replicas as the described deployment fact.

Evidence: supported; author-supplied manuscript fact.

Resolution test: the revised Overview still states three replicas.

authorized: only manuscript.md, review.md, and paper-decisions.md in the isolated project
excluded: future stage prompts before their turn
scope.output_language: Chinese workflow reports and English manuscript

confirmed_after_grill: The evaluation is one 30-minute run that paused one follower for 10 seconds.
The service continued to respond during that run.
The author permits a bounded observational statement and the direct subject-verb agreement repair.
required_findings: the Overview subject-verb agreement defect is directly repairable
the Evaluation evidence-strength defect requires an author decision before claim narrowing

forbidden_actions: edit manuscript.md during either Review or Grill
edit review.md or paper-decisions.md during Revise
ask Grill to revisit the direct grammar finding or passed units
lose or renumber source finding and coverage-unit IDs between stages
apply a pending or rejected decision
claim that the bounded observation proves a broader guarantee
drop D0 or any original finding from the closure map
hard_gates: Initial Review gives stable unit/finding IDs, classifies only the claim-strength item as author clarification, and ends with a complete receipt.

Grill preserves the source IDs and resolution test, writes a pending version before confirmation, then appends a complete bounded confirmed successor while preserving the pending history and D0; no other file changes.

Revise fixes subject-verb agreement, replaces the unsupported guarantee only with the confirmed bounded observation, preserves layout and tokens, and maps every original finding to a closure state after a full-scope post-audit.
Final Review reuses the original IDs, verifies both resolution tests, finds no promoted evidence or new defect, and reports matching totals with Unreviewed: 0.
expected_behavior: Keep the initial grammar defect separate from the scientific claim-strength decision.
Carry the exact Review finding and unit IDs through the decision record and closure map.
Treat pending clarification as non-terminal and not as revision authority until the author confirmation arrives.
Preserve D0 and materially rejected partition, durability, and latency additions.
Re-audit both changed and unchanged units after revision.
Close findings only after their original resolution tests pass.

rubric.criterion: Initial Review inventories and ledgers both sections, both paragraphs, both sentences, and lexical occurrences with stable IDs and a complete receipt.
Initial Review separates the direct agreement defect from the evidence-strength finding that needs an author decision.
Initial Review gives both findings observable resolution tests and retains risk-bearing lexical anchors.
Opening Grill discusses only the author-decision finding and persists it as pending with source IDs before confirmation.
Confirmed Grill record preserves D0, source IDs, the original resolution test, evidence limits, allowed edit, and rejected additions.
Grill never edits the manuscript or claims a finding closed.
Revise repairs clients sends without routing that ordinary grammar issue back through Grill.
Revise states only the confirmed bounded 30-minute one-follower observation and adds no broader property.
Revise preserves Quorum, three replicas, two sections, two paragraphs, D0, and read-only handoff files.
Revise maps every original finding to a closure state and re-audits changed and unchanged units with Unreviewed: 0.
Final Review reuses original IDs and verifies both original resolution tests without claiming new evidence.
Final Review reports no dropped finding or new defect and ends with matching totals, last-unit states, and Unreviewed: 0.
